verdict.rationale: Quo's pricing page lists first-party HubSpot and Salesforce integrations, so a native CRM connection exists. Nothing in the evidence says calls and texts are logged automatically or matched to the correct CRM contact. The API and MCP items describe pulling or acting on data, not automatic CRM logging, so they add no credit. missing for 10: documentation that calls and texts sync automatically to the CRM, contact-matching behavior, details on what activity data is logged, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a sales lead, calls and texts log to my CRM automatically against the right contact
